info.title: KnowFlow AI
info.description: Enterprise Knowledge & SOP Agent backend API

get.description:
Returns application health status, database connectivity, and auth state.
Real probe: does not fake connection status.

Lightweight process liveness check.
Returns 200 OK as long as the process is running.
Used by container orchestrators (Kubernetes, Docker) for restart decisions.

schema.title: Response Liveness Probe Api Health Live Get

get.description:
Deep readiness probe.

Checks:
- Database connectivity and pgvector extension availability.
- Auth provider configuration.
- Application version and environment.

Returns HTTP 200 if all checks pass, HTTP 503 if any critical check fails.
Used by load balancers/orchestrators to determine traffic routing.

post.description: Uploads a real document (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV) to Supabase Storage and initiates ingestion.

get.description: Lists real ingested documents from the database with pagination, filters, and chunk counts.
Returns detailed information for a document, including extracted chunks and signed download URL.

delete.description: Deletes a document from Supabase Storage and PostgreSQL.

post.description: Retries processing for a failed document.

Executes a grounded question-answering query against authorized company documentation.
Enforces server-side authorization: workspace_id, user_id, and access permissions are derived
exclusively from the verified user_context.

get.description: Lists conversations belonging to the authenticated user in the current workspace.

schema.title: Response List Conversations Api Chat Conversations Get

get.description: Retrieves full conversation with messages and verified citations.

delete.description: Deletes a conversation and its messages.

post.description: Submits positive or negative feedback on an AI answer.

Executes hybrid (dense vector + sparse BM25) search across authorized company documents.
Server-side authorization is strictly enforced based on user_context.

post.description:
Triggers an automated evaluation benchmark across the golden test suite.
Calculates Hit Rate @ 1/3/5, MRR, NDCG@5, Faithfulness, and reports
False Positives and False Negatives separately.

get.description: Returns the most recent automated evaluation summary.
